name: Shimamaki (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shimamaki village emblem in yellow: a disc with a stylised bird wing and beak.
history: Municipal flag of Shimamaki, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 22 December 1967.

features.role: Shimamaki village emblem — a disc with a stylised bird wing and beak
